subject: executor: fix `BatchPoint` leads to tidb panic when KeyPartition column is part of multi-column index (#51315)
summary: Reviewed commit vs first parent. The fix removes `colPos` from `core.GetPhysID` and, for KEY partition, forces the `expression.Column.Index` used by `tables.ForKeyPruning.LocateKeyPartition` to 0, matching the single-element datum slice passed in; this prevents an out-of-range panic when the partition column is not the first column in a multi-column unique index (or multi-column common handle). Change is consistent with existing PointGet KEY-partition fast-path logic. No remaining Blocker/High issues found. Later upstream history refactors this area (e.g. removes `GetPhysID`) without evidence of a follow-up fix for a regression here.
